comments.content: Rules of Hooks violation: useSystemAgents conditionally calls useLocalSystemAgents / useRemoteSystemAgents based on store.getState(). Hooks must be called unconditionally in the same order. Also useLocalSystemAgents does not return anything, so callers receive undefined instead of Agent[]. Refactor to a single hook that selects defaultaides via useSelector and branches internally without conditional hook calls.

store.getState() is used directly inside a hook, so changes to settings.defaultaides will not trigger re-renders. Use useSelector to read defaultaides reactively and avoid reading the store outside React render. Also useRemoteSystemAgents reads store.getState() again and returns early before useEffect, breaking hook order.

initialState.defaultaides is set to 'settings.defaultaides', a translation key, not a URL. This will cause the http check to fail and the remote loader to be used with an invalid URL. Initialize as null or '' and treat the translation separately.

Typo in action creator: setefaultAides is missing a 'd'. The name is inconsistent with the state field defaultaides and with usage in DefaultaidesSettings. Rename to setDefaultAides and update all imports/exports.

Translation key mismatch: en-us/ja-jp/ru-ru/zh-tw add 'defaultaides' string at settings level, while DataSettings expects 'settings.data.default_aides.title' and 'settings.data.default_aides.repo_url' etc. zh-cn adds default_aides object but other locales do not. Align keys across all locales to settings.data.default_aides.*.

File is created with executable mode 100755. TSX source files should be 0644. Also component name DefaultaidesSettings vs key default_aides is inconsistent; consider renaming to DefaultAidesSettings for consistency.
